Enum Class ViewTUI.LayoutTier

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<ViewTUI.LayoutTier>
it.polimi.ingsw.client.ui.tui.ViewTUI.LayoutTier
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<ViewTUI.LayoutTier>, Constable
Enclosing class:
ViewTUI
private static enum ViewTUI.LayoutTier extends Enum<ViewTUI.LayoutTier>
Responsive breakpoints that control the column-width proportions of the three-panel layout.

The tier is selected by ViewTUI.computeLayout() based on the current terminal width and stored in ViewTUI.currentTier. A WINCH signal triggers a full redraw which re-evaluates the tier automatically.
